headline: HuyenBao v11.20 — business P&L + R&D investment + market share + catalogue sorted by difficulty + ads reduce health
summary: Backlog-clearing pass: business detail (P&L + market share + R&D), catalogue re-sorted easiest→hardest with unlock hints, advertising/hype posts now reduce health (stress from promo grind). All four Huyen-Hoc-AI features (Kinh Dịch / Tử Vi / Phong Thuỷ / Tarot) unchanged. AI audit pass: confirmed the 5 existing AI mechanisms (random oracle popup, story endpoint, divine (I Ching), tuvi, phongthuy, tarot, post generator) are wired correctly with 3-layer fallback (Ollama local → ZAI cloud → deterministic local). Elliot crypto MVP: already linked from the Market tab in v11.19 (https://elliott.huyenbao.com/) — Phase 2 ECOSYSTEM.md roadmap referenced from there.
features: Business P&L summary card at the top of BizTab: revenue (annualised, gross), costs (per-branch overhead + manager fees + farm/fac line upkeep), net profit, market share (% of notional 60-branch local market)

R&D investment panel: invest $50k–$5M+ for a 365-game-day biz-multiplier boost (log-scaled: $50k→+5%, $500k→+20%, $5M caps at +25%). Active boost shown with days remaining. Re-investing replaces the active boost (doesn't stack)
bizRevenue / bizCosts / bizNet / bizMarketShare / bizRndMult / investBizRnd helpers added to engine.ts; bizMultiplier now reads bizRndMult()
GameState.bizRnd field (backfilled in migrate) stores the active R&D investment
Catalogue categories now sorted by minimum item price ascending — Phone ($999) first, Private jet ($10M) last. Previously insertion order mixed cheap with expensive
Locked categories (Sport bike / Car requiring moto / car licence) now show a 🔒 hint with the licence name that unlocks them, instead of just 'licence needed'. Owned licences show a ✓ chip

Ads/hype posts reduce health: addPost() with boost ≥ 1.4 (hype = 1.6, viral brand deals = 2.0) now costs 0.3–1.2 health per post, scaled by boost. Queued toast notifies the player of the health cost ('Hype post — stressed from promo grind, health −N')
Catalogue note explains the sort + unlock-hint behaviour
AI audit pass: 5 AI mechanisms (oracle popup / story / divine / tuvi / phongthuy / tarot / post) all confirmed wired with 3-layer fallback. No bugs found

Elliot crypto MVP: the Market-tab crypto hook (added v11.19) IS the MVP — links to https://elliott.huyenbao.com/ for the dedicated Elliott Wave crypto app. Phase 2 ECOSYSTEM.md roadmap referenced from there
Version bumped to v11.20 at FRONT of app name (v11.20 HuyenBao)
